<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_USIRegistration" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/usi-registration">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Tweet" name="Tweet to friends"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_USIRegistration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant and sports institute application" processRef="Process_USIRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweet" name="Post tweet" sourceRef="Task_Tweet" targetRef="Participant_Twitter" messageRef="Message_Tweet"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_USIRegistration" name="New Application for Registering for an USI course" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_USIRegistration">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Registration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCourse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AccountExists</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckEligibleUniversity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_UniversityEligible</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestActivation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitActivation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AccountReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TweetDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Tweet</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TweetMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvidePayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_CourseTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ApplicationSystem" name="Application system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAvailability</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SlotsAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowCoursesDates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NoSlots</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Registration" name="Course registration desired"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckAvailability" name="Check course availability"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SlotsAvailable" name="Are slots available?" default="Flow_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCoursesDates" name="Show available courses and dates"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select a course"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAccount" name="Check whether an account exists"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountExists" name="Does an account exist?" default="Flow_NoAccount"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckEligibleUniversity" name="Check eligible university registration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_UniversityEligible" name="Registered at an eligible university?" default="Flow_NotEligible"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WaitActivation" name="Wait for activation response"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountReady" name="Account ready"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log into account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetDecision" name="Tweet to friends?" default="Flow_SkipTweet"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Tweet" name="Tweet to friends who might want to join" messageRef="Message_Tweet"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetMerge" name="Continue registration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteRegistration" name="Complete course registration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePayment" name="Provide payment information"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CourseTicket" name="Course ticket received"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoSlots" name="No course slots available"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_CheckAvailability" sourceRef="Start_Registration" targetRef="Task_CheckAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAvailability_Slots" sourceRef="Task_CheckAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_SlotsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SlotsAvailable" name="Slots available" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsAvailable" targetRef="Task_ShowCoursesDates">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">slotsAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSlots" name="No slots available" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsAvailable" targetRef="End_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Show_SelectCourse" sourceRef="Task_ShowCoursesDates" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_CheckAccount" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Task_CheckAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAccount_AccountExists" sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists" name="Account exists" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hasAccount</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAccount" name="No account" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Task_CheckEligibleUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckUniversity_Eligible" sourceRef="Task_CheckEligibleUniversity" targetRef="Gateway_UniversityEligible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Eligible" name="Registered at an eligible university" sourceRef="Gateway_UniversityEligible" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">eligibleUniversity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEligible" name="Not registered at an eligible university" sourceRef="Gateway_UniversityEligible" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_AccountReady" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Wait" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Task_WaitActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_AccountReady" sourceRef="Task_WaitActivation" targetRef="Gateway_AccountReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountReady_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountReady" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_TweetDecision" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Gateway_TweetDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tweet" name="Tweet" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetDecision" targetRef="Task_Tweet">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">tweetToFriends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipTweet" name="Do not tweet" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetDecision" targetRef="Gateway_TweetMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tweet_Merge" sourceRef="Task_Tweet" targetRef="Gateway_TweetMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_CompleteRegistration" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetMerge" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complete_ProvidePayment" sourceRef="Task_CompleteRegistration" targetRef="Task_ProvidePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvidePayment_Ticket" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePayment" targetRef="End_CourseTicket"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
